description: The article proposes using structured trace information, analogous to on-line requirement traceability in software engineering, to capture problem-solving steps.
title: Trace-based capture of problem-solving process for process-level assessment and feedback

description: A trace-based measurement protocol that converts raw multi-channel trace data into SRL processes.
title: Trace parser with action library and process library for measuring SRL from multi-channel data

title: TRACE (TRansformer for Academic Course-grade Estimation)

description: The article distinguishes two SJT developmental approaches.
title: Traditional versus construct-driven SJT development approaches

description: The article argues that effects of game elements can appear during the learning process even when pre-post learning outcomes do not differ, so research should measure performance during training.
title: Training-phase process measurement alongside pretest–posttest outcomes

description: The article presents a framework that applies college readiness benchmarks to longitudinal middle-grades assessment data, assigning each student a series of up to six on-track status indicators and grouping students into six trajectory patterns.
title: Trajectory-based early indicator framework for college readiness monitoring

description: The article operationalizes transactivity as reasoning made explicit that builds on prior reasoning in a discussion.
title: Transactivity coding scheme for self- and other-oriented reasoning

description: A reusable analysis pipeline that operationalizes interactional fluency and direction-sensitive linguistic uptake for spoken AI practice \"using metrics extractable from diarized ASR output without manual linguistic annotation.\" The fluency component extracts seven features from word-level timestamps
title: Transcript-based interactional fluency and direction-sensitive uptake analysis

description: The article introduces an approach for testing whether teacher value added depends on the test scale: estimate value added on the original scale, then \"applying extremely mild nonlinear transformations to the original scale and re-estimating the value added.\" Because \"by definition at most one of th
title: Transformation-and-re-estimation method for probing scale sensitivity of teacher value added

description: The article describes how transformer LLMs such as BERT generate sentence-level embeddings through attention layers where \"each embedding in the sequence is compared with and modified by each other embedding based on their similarity.\" This allows word meanings to be contextually influenced, produci
title: Transformer attention-based semantic representation for automated constructed response scoring

description: A deep knowledge tracing framework for the ASSISTments dataset that predicts students' responses to end-of-unit test problems from action logs of in-unit assignments.
title: Transformer-encoder knowledge tracing framework with IEU/IIU input vectors

description: Transition Network Analysis (TNA) models learning processes as networks of discrete behavioural states connected by directed, probabilistic transitions, computed here with a web-based TNA Shiny app.
title: Transition Network Analysis (TNA)

description: The article presents a transition taxonomy that outlines the range of social transitions occurring in classrooms, distilled from prior literature and printed as Table 1.
title: Transition taxonomy: pragmatic and pedagogical social transitions organized by activity impact, group-size direction, and fluidity

description: Because think-aloud protocols face reactivity and veridicality risks, the review recommends that researchers \"view think-aloud data as indicators of only a part of self-regulated reading process rather than a full picture of it\".
title: Triangulated multi-source assessment of self-regulated reading processes

description: A methodological framework combining three elements to examine writing processes of struggling adult writers: observation of collaborative writing tasks, analyses of written texts, and structured individual interviews with retrospective and prospective parts.
title: Triangulated multi-source assessment of writing processes and writing knowledge

description: The article develops a triangulated analysis method combining three equally valued approaches to understand CPS at group level: \"(a) directed content analysis of the actualized CPS in groups, (b) process analysis and visualizations, and (c) qualitative cases\".
title: Triangulated three-method analysis of collaborative problem-solving enactment

description: The trifactor model is a structural equation modeling approach developed by Bauer et al.
title: trifactor model

description: Trio-ethnography brings three participants (here two computing educators with contrasting instructional philosophies and one undergraduate student) into reflective conversation as co-inquirers.
title: Trio-ethnography

description: The article proposes adapting trustworthiness criteria from the ML community as a structured lens for LLM evaluation in education.
title: Trustworthiness lens for evaluating LLMs in education
